name: Letter fall
what: A tall word slams in, then its letters come loose one after another - each wobbles, tips over and falls out of the frame spinning; the letters that stay are left alone.

learned_from.what: the tall word losing its letters one by one

motion: slam 12 f + a bump; each letter wobbles 6 f, tips 6 f, falls 22 f (accelerating), 10 f apart
